events.title: Scenario: AI workload growth raises substation capacity pressure in major load corridors
events.summary: AI-driven loading concentrated in data-center clusters could increase substation and transformer stress in certain corridors. Near-term pressure would favor short-lead resilience options and accelerated procurement planning.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC/converter integration faces longer schedules as specialized transformer components tighten
events.summary: Specialized transformer component tightness could delay HVDC and transmission projects, pushing planners toward interim electrical solutions or design changes that reduce reliance on long-lead bulk transformers.

events.title: Scenario: Inverter-heavy renewable penetration complicates protection coordination at regional substations
events.summary: Rising inverter-based renewables can alter fault dynamics and protection behavior at substations, creating a need for adaptive protection and additional support devices to maintain reliability.

events.title: Scenario: Data-center operators move toward modular substations and BESS for resilience
events.summary: Modular substations combined with battery storage present a short-to-midterm resilience option for data centers facing transformer procurement or interconnection delays. Adoption depends on integration approvals and local manufacturing availability.

events.title: Scenario: Artisanal and export-route signals suggest volatility in mineral flows for magnet and core materials
events.summary: Volatility in artisanal production and export routes could produce short-term variability in upstream mineral availability for transformer components, elevating manufacturing and schedule risk.

events.title: Scenario: Automation and digital-twin adoption accelerate transformer manufacturing throughput but expose a skills gap
events.summary: OEMs adopting automation and digital twins could boost transformer production capacity, but workforce and data-quality constraints may limit realization of those gains in the near term.

events.title: Scenario: Increased interconnection studies and planning requests shift near-term funding toward system studies
events.summary: Shifting budget emphasis to interconnection studies could delay hardware procurement but lower long-term specification risk; consultancies and digital services may see increased near-term demand.

events.title: Scenario: Distributed solar growth drives transformer retrofit and tap-changer activity on feeders
events.summary: Widespread distributed solar growth can drive a retrofit cycle for distribution transformers and tap-changers, raising field-service demand and materials procurement pressure.

events.title: Scenario: Increased ransomware/scada intrusion indicators push substation hardening demand
events.summary: A rise in SCADA/OT intrusion indicators could accelerate substation cybersecurity investments and architectural changes, increasing vendor demand for hardened control hardware and monitoring services.

events.title: Scenario: AI predictive-maintenance pilots reduce transformer forced outages but data-quality limits scale
events.summary: AI predictive maintenance can lower forced outage risk where data quality is sufficient, but scaling requires improvements in telemetry, data labeling, and workflow integration.
